queue.title: Translation Queue
queue.noVideosDescription: Add your first video to start tracking translations. Paste a YouTube URL and select target languages.
queue.archiveConfirmation: Are you sure you want to archive this video? It will be moved to the archive and can be restored later.
queue.videoArchivedDescription: The video has been moved to archive.

addVideo.videoDetailsDescription: Paste a YouTube URL to add a video to your translation queue.

addVideo.videoTitleDescription: Leave empty to use YouTube title (requires API key)

addVideo.selectLanguagesDescription: Please select at least one target language for translation.
addVideo.videoAddedDescription: The video has been added to your translation queue.

archive.title: Archive
archive.description: Videos that have been archived from the translation queue.
archive.noVideosDescription: Videos you archive from the queue will appear here.

scheduled.title: Scheduled
scheduled.noTranslationsDescription: Schedule translations for publishing to see them here.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.description: Overview of your translation activity and metrics.

channels.description: Manage your YouTube channels for publishing translations.

channels.deleteConfirmation: Are you sure you want to delete this channel? This action cannot be undone.
channels.channelAdded: The channel has been added successfully.
channels.channelUpdated: The channel has been updated successfully.

languages.languageAddedDescription: The language has been added successfully.
